sys_script_fix.description: Initial load for the External User Mapping table. Creates a Not found mapping for every active Konversational America user who does not have a Xero mapping yet. Existing mappings (Matched or Not found) are left unchanged, so the script is safe to run more than once. Run once after the application is installed in a new instance. The daily job (Xero - Retry Not Found Users, Mon–Fri) then matches all pending users with a single call to Xero.
sys_script_fix.name: Xero - Initial load of External User Map
